liquids.answer: Ethiopian Airlines's restricted-items page does not state a 100 ml limit. It says aerosols, perfumes and alcohol-based medicines are allowed in carry-on and checked baggage up to 0.5 kg or L per article and 2.0 kg or L in total, and that flammable liquids such as fuels, paints and thinners are not allowed in either.

sections.h: What Ethiopian Airlines's own page says about liquids
sections.p: The restricted-items page lists liquid-type goods in a table with columns for carry-on and check-in. It also notes in its FAQ that Ethiopian may have restrictions on carrying liquids, gels and certain hazardous items in carry-on bags.

list: Not on the page: a 100 ml per container limit or a one-litre bag. Those come from the security rules of the airport you depart from.

faq: Does Ethiopian Airlines state a 100 ml liquid limit?

Not on its restricted-items page. The page gives a 0.5 kg or L per article and 2.0 kg or L total limit for aerosols, perfumes and alcohol-based medicines, and says Ethiopian may have restrictions on liquids and gels in carry-on bags.
Can I take paint or thinners on Ethiopian Airlines?
No. The restricted-items page marks flammable liquids such as fuels, paints and thinners as not allowed in carry-on or in checked baggage.
